metadataDescriptions.FULL_NAME_LABEL: Full legal name and surname according to civil registry or identity provider.
metadataDescriptions.EMAIL_ADDRESS_LABEL: Electronic mail address linked to the institutional account.
metadataDescriptions.AVATAR_IMAGE_LABEL: Profile image URL retrieved from the verified provider.
metadataDescriptions.TRUST_LEVEL_LABEL: Algorithmic coefficient that determines the weight of identity actions.

operationalSignals.AUTHORITY_SYNCHRONIZATION_SUCCESS: Authority synchronization successfully consolidated in the Primary Ledger.
